messages.subject: AIC as a criteraia for selection among models of different
parts:
Dear List

I would like to ask this question:

Is it right to use the AIC to select among rival models of different mode=
l families? in other words if I am having group of CDS based models and a=
nother group of MCDS based models is it OK to use AIC to select among the=
m? Also what is the validity of AIC as a model selection criteria among t=
hese models if they have different right truncation points?



----------------------------------------
Husam El Alqamy, B.Sc., M.Phil.
Protected Area Coordinator,
Terrestrial Environmental Research Center, TERC
Environmental Agency Abu Dhabi
